name: rerout

author: ngonidzashe_mangudya

commands.name: create-link
commands.title: Create Short Link
commands.subtitle: Rerout
commands.description: Create a branded short link and copy it to the clipboard.

commands.name: my-links
commands.title: My Links
commands.subtitle: Rerout
commands.description: Browse your links, copy short URLs, open targets and QR codes, or delete.

commands.name: tags
commands.title: Manage Tags
commands.subtitle: Rerout

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your Rerout project API key (rrk_… or a sandbox rrk_test_… key). Create one in the dashboard under API keys.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: Leave empty to use Rerout. Set only for staging or self-hosted deployments.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
